title: ios-acceptance-page
responsibility: Owns the ios-acceptance-page build or maintenance script.

inputs.name: SimulatorPage.constructor.simulator
inputs.description: The simulator socket path and runtime are stored by the page helper and passed to appium-remote-debugger when it connects. The implementation does not validate either string.

inputs.name: SimulatorPage.evaluate.expression
inputs.description: JavaScript appended after pagePrelude and executed in the selected app page. It is retried after connection or execution failures, up to eight attempts.

inputs.name: SimulatorPage.until.expression
inputs.description: JavaScript appended after pagePrelude and reevaluated through evaluate while waiting. It uses evaluate's retry behavior and must return text containing wanted for a match.

inputs.name: SimulatorPage.until.wanted
inputs.description: Substring that must occur in the text returned by evaluate for until to resolve. Matching uses case-sensitive String.includes.

inputs.name: SimulatorPage.until.seconds
inputs.description: Polling window in seconds, used to compute a Date.now deadline. Defaults to 60; the value is not validated and one evaluate call can run past the deadline.

outputs.name: SimulatorPage.evaluate
outputs.description: Text representation of the page expression's result: truthy objects are JSON-stringified and other values use String(value ?? ''). It resolves on the first successful evaluation or rejects with Error after eight failed attempts.

outputs.name: SimulatorPage.until
outputs.description: A string returned by evaluate that includes wanted. Polling waits one second between unsuccessful checks and rejects with Error when the deadline passes without a match.

outputs.name: SimulatorPage.reset
outputs.description: Resolves after clearing the cached inspector reference and disconnecting the previous inspector if present. A rejected disconnect is swallowed.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: An Error is thrown by evaluate after all eight connect or execute attempts fail, or by until when its deadline expires without wanted appearing in the evaluated text.
